alerts.title: Security Definer View
alerts.description: Detects views defined with the SECURITY DEFINER property. These views enforce Postgres permissions and row level security policies (RLS) of the view creator, rather than that of the querying user

            ELSE 'pending'::text

   FROM channel_invitations i
  WHERE auth_mfa_satisfied() AND sender_id = auth.uid();

functions.name: is_blocked(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_blocked(p_blocker uuid, p_blocked uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$SELECT public.auth_mfa_satisfied() AND (
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.user_blocks WHERE blocker_id = p_blocker AND blocked_id = p_blocked))$function$

functions.name: is_contact(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_contact(p_user_a uuid, p_user_b uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$SELECT public.auth_mfa_satisfied() AND (
  SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.chats WHERE type = 'direct' AND status = 'active' AND direct_pair_key = LEAST(p_user_a::text, p_user_b::text) || '::' || GREATEST(p_user_a::text, p_user_b::text)))$function$

functions.name: can_view_avatar(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_avatar(p_owner uuid, p_viewer uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  -- Preserve the MFA guard added by the newer remote migration; only the
  -- block-direction check changes here.
  SELECT public.auth_mfa_satisfied() AND (
    CASE
      WHEN p_owner = p_viewer THEN true
      WHEN public.is_blocked(p_owner, p_viewer) THEN false
      ELSE COALESCE((
        SELECT CASE
          WHEN profile_photo_visibility = 'everyone' THEN true
          WHEN profile_photo_visibility = 'nobody' THEN false
          WHEN profile_photo_visibility = 'contacts' THEN public.is_contact(p_owner, p_viewer)
          WHEN profile_photo_visibility = 'contacts_except' THEN
            public.is_contact(p_owner, p_viewer) AND NOT (p_viewer = ANY(profile_photo_exclusions))
          ELSE false END
        FROM public.user_settings WHERE user_id = p_owner
      ), true)
    END
  );
$function$

functions.name: can_view_story(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_view_story(p_owner uuid, p_viewer uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$SELECT public.auth_mfa_satisfied() AND (
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_owner = p_viewer THEN true
    WHEN public.is_blocked_either_way(p_owner, p_viewer) THEN false
    ELSE COALESCE((
      SELECT CASE
        WHEN story_visibility = 'everyone' THEN true
        WHEN story_visibility = 'nobody' THEN false
        WHEN story_visibility = 'contacts' THEN public.is_contact(p_owner, p_viewer)
        WHEN story_visibility = 'contacts_except' THEN
          public.is_contact(p_owner, p_viewer) AND NOT (p_viewer = ANY(story_exclusions))
        ELSE false END
      FROM public.user_settings WHERE user_id = p_owner
    ), true)
  END)$function$

functions.name: auth_mfa_satisfied()
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.auth_mfa_satisfied()
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND (
    auth.jwt()->>'aal' = 'aal2' OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM auth.mfa_factors WHERE user_id = auth.uid() AND status = 'verified'
    )
  );
$function$

functions.name: can_access_chat_message(uuid,boolean)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.can_access_chat_message(p_message_id uuid, p_include_deleted boolean DEFAULT false)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT auth.uid() IS NOT NULL AND public.auth_mfa_satisfied() AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.messages m
    WHERE m.id = p_message_id
      AND (p_include_deleted OR NOT m.deleted_for_everyone)
      AND NOT public.is_message_deleted_for_user(m.id, auth.uid())
      AND (
        (m.chat_id IS NOT NULL AND (
          public.is_chat_member(m.chat_id, auth.uid())
          OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM public.chat_requests r
            WHERE r.chat_id = m.chat_id AND r.recipient_id = auth.uid() AND r.status = 'pending'
          )
        ))
        OR (m.channel_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.channels c WHERE c.id = m.channel_id))
      )
  );
$function$

functions.name: get_channel_staff(uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_channel_staff(p_channel_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(user_id uuid, role text, joined_at timestamp with time zone, username text, display_name text, avatar_url text)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT cs.user_id, cs.role, cs.joined_at, p.username, p.display_name, p.avatar_url
  FROM public.channel_staff cs
  JOIN public.profiles_visible p ON p.id = cs.user_id
  WHERE cs.channel_id = p_channel_id
    AND public.is_channel_staff(p_channel_id, auth.uid())
  ORDER BY CASE WHEN cs.role = 'owner' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, cs.joined_at ASC, cs.user_id ASC;
$function$

functions.name: authorize_channel_post_media_read(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_channel_post_media_read(p_upload_id uuid, p_channel_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, path text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.auth_mfa_satisfied() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication and MFA required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT f.bucket, f.path
  FROM public.file_uploads f
  JOIN public.messages m ON (m.file_upload_id = f.id OR m.media_thumbnail_upload_id = f.id)
  JOIN public.channels c ON c.id = m.channel_id
  WHERE f.id = p_upload_id
    AND f.bucket = 'channel-media'
    AND m.channel_id = p_channel_id
    AND NOT m.deleted_for_everyone
    AND m.deleted_at IS NULL
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Media unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
END $function$

functions.name: authorize_forwarded_channel_media_read(uuid,uuid)
functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.authorize_forwarded_channel_media_read(p_upload_id uuid, p_message_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, path text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR NOT public.auth_mfa_satisfied() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Authentication and MFA required' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  IF NOT public.can_access_chat_message(p_message_id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Message unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT f.bucket, f.path
  FROM public.file_uploads f
  JOIN public.messages m ON (m.file_upload_id = f.id OR m.media_thumbnail_upload_id = f.id)
  WHERE f.id = p_upload_id
    AND f.bucket = 'channel-media'
    AND m.id = p_message_id
    AND m.chat_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT m.deleted_for_everyone
  LIMIT 1;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Media unavailable' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.is_channel_staff(p_channel_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT public.auth_mfa_satisfied()
    AND p_user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND p_user_id = (SELECT auth.uid())
    AND private.is_channel_staff(p_channel_id, (SELECT auth.uid()));
$function$

private_functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.is_channel_staff(p_channel_id uuid, p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
  SELECT p_user_id IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM public.channel_staff
    WHERE channel_id = p_channel_id AND user_id = p_user_id
  );
$function$
